{{Top|leg}}
The '''Meirm Sea''' was a major body of [[Water/Legends|water]] on [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]], known for its high [[Acid/Legends|acidic]] content. The eastern edge of the Meirm Sea was known as the [[Copper Coast]], due to the amount of the pulverized [[Copper/Legends|copper]] in the sand.

Because of its proximity to the sea, in the early morning, [[Meirm City]] was often covered with a coppery fog composed of sea spray and chemicals that could harm the skin of sensitive species. This mist left behind a copper-colored dust if not washed away before midday.
